title: Colosseum 1.1.6
summary: Keyboard-first navigation, multilingual Tankoyomi sources, more durable account state, and smoother startup and playback recovery.

highlights.title: Arrows keep moving
highlights.body: Arrow-key navigation now follows the visual layout across worlds and keeps moving through overflowing or scrollable content instead of stopping at the viewport edge.

highlights.title: Multilingual chapter sources
highlights.body: Saved language settings, safer source matching, more reliable fallback behavior, and stronger page-image validation improve Tankoyomi chapter mode.

highlights.title: Account state lasts
highlights.body: Remembered sessions, safer refresh handling, and more durable profile, activity, history, and recovery state make account use more reliable across launches and devices.

highlights.title: Smoother interaction
highlights.body: More recurring work now stays away from the main interface path, reducing unnecessary background activity and improving startup and navigation responsiveness.

highlights.title: Stremio startup recovers
highlights.body: The bundled stream server can recover after a failed startup instead of leaving Theatre stuck behind the failed launch state.

highlights.title: One-time trust reset
highlights.body: Colosseum 1.1.6 establishes a new update-signing trust root. Install this release manually once when coming from 1.1.5 or earlier; automatic updates resume normally from 1.1.6 onward.
